definitions.verdictAccuracy: status equals oracle status / all tasks
definitions.falseAcceptance: evaluator says valid-complete|valid-incomplete where oracle says invalid|unsupported|ambiguous / oracle non-valid tasks
definitions.falseRejection: evaluator says invalid where oracle says valid-* / oracle valid tasks
definitions.overRefusal: evaluator says unsupported|ambiguous where oracle gives a definite verdict / oracle definite tasks
definitions.underRefusal: evaluator gives a definite verdict where oracle says unsupported|ambiguous / those tasks
definitions.firstErrorLocalization: first invalid line equal and invalid_at=step / oracle step-invalid tasks
